facts.fact: 上路三夜不习惯野外；三个男人防御队出身各有分工
facts.anchor: They’d been traveling for three nights, and she was still not used to living on the road.

facts.fact: Tolan 约十七八岁最年轻；清晨猎兔烤做早饭
facts.anchor: Tolan was one of the younger members of the defense, maybe seventeen or eighteen.

facts.fact: Tolan 坦白恋爱想求婚；Andra 催他回家就去问
facts.anchor: Actually, I know I love her. I’ve been thinking about asking her to marry me.

facts.fact: Daegal 五十多岁银发黑须带疤；例行询问她能否扛住
facts.anchor: He was somewhere in his fifties, with dark, close cut hair and a matching beard both streaked with silver.

facts.fact: 断水；前方约二十英里有 Nivek 村可歇脚
facts.anchor: Daegal said there is a village called Nivek about twenty miles ahead.

facts.fact: Nivek 死村：窗碎门裂、血迹腐臭、空无一人；Daegal 念叨不对劲
facts.anchor: Every window lay shattered upon the earth; doors were cracked and splintered

facts.fact: 低语+狂风非她魔法所致——魔法沉睡，“是别的东西”
facts.anchor: Whispers filled the air around her, agonized voices muttering gruesome memories in her ears

facts.fact: 屋内新鲜尸体脚太小=孩子；林中尖叫“它根本没走”
facts.anchor: glimpsed the fresh corpses just inside the home, the dirty feet sticking out much too small to be that of an adult.

facts.fact: Daegal 被非人力量卷上半空消失；坐骑腹部被撕开倒地
facts.anchor: An unearthly screech permeated the air, and his body was snatched around his midsection and yanked upward.

facts.fact: 逃亡摔落：后脑撞地眼前炸白光；怪物扑下马人立甩落两人
facts.anchor: Andra’s vision burst with flashes of light as her head slammed into the earth, the breath whooshing from her lungs.

facts.fact: Tolan 吹哨引开仍被扑中——当众撕碎吞食；Lucas 捂她的嘴警告
facts.anchor: The monster devoured Tolan, ripping his limbs from his body and feasting upon his flesh and blood

facts.fact: Lucas 一箭正中 Tolan 头骨终结痛苦——她追着表哥冲进黑夜
facts.anchor: Lucas nocked an arrow and fired true, straight into Tolan’s skull. The screaming immediately ceased
